blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Civil society groups and local stakeholders have flagged serious deficiencies in the public consultation process conducted by the Mines and Geosciences Bureau for the proposed 10,000-hectare Mineral Reservation Area covering portions of Puerto Galera and San Teodoro. In an update released following the Nov. 24 public hearing in San Teodoro, Fr. Edwin Gariguez, Executive Director of Diocesan Social Action Center of the Diocese of Calapan, raised 10 major concerns, ranging from inadequate ecological assessment to questions about procedural compliance and the exclusion of affected communities.
